 * execution has started and finished.
 *
 * @param <R> The type of the result.
 * @param <E> The type of any {@link ExecutionException} cause.

methods.comment: Blocks until the task has started, or has been canceled without having been started.

methods.name: public final void blockUntilFinished()
methods.comment: Blocks until the task has finished, or has been canceled without having been started.
